brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Tool rack that hangs on wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: Three-piece horizontal bar (piece:-1,0,0;full, piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full) with keyhole hanger accessories on rear face (accessory:0#-1,0#3, accessory:0#0,0#1, accessory:0#1,0#0) for wall mounting
Three hook plates (hex-acc-hook) on front face (accessory:0#-1,0#5, accessory:0#0,0#5, accessory:0#1,0#4) each provides two hooks for hanging tools

finish.summary: 3-cell horizontal wall rack with keyhole hangers on back for wall mounting and three double-hook plates on front for hand tools. Props for hooks (gaffer tape/cable coils) are the only ones supported on this accessory, but the hardware itself shows the tool-rack function.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
